newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-VAN DER ELST, NEWCOMERS IN BELGIAN TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VAN DER ELST, NEWCOMERS IN BELGIAN TEAM.

text.p: New Belgium coach Georges Leekens on Friday called up three newcomers and Club Brugge captain Franky Van der Elst for next Tuesday's soccer friendly against Northern Ireland.
Van der Elst retired from the national team with 69 caps in December 1994 after he was constantly jeered by the home crowd during Belgium's embarrassing 4-1 defeat by Spain.
But last week Leekens asked Belgium's recently named player of 1996 if he would return to shore up a flagging defence.
The three uncapped players are Dominique Lemoine and Lokonda M'Penza from surprise first division leaders Mouscron, and Bart De Roover from third-ranked Lierse.
The game in Belfast serves as preparation for next month's World Cup European qualifying group seven match against Wales.
Fiorentina's Luis Oliveira, who is getting married on Sunday, and PSV Eindhoven's Marc Degryse are the main absentees from the 20-man squad.
Leekens left Mouscron last month to take charge of the national team from Wilfried Van Moer, who was sacked after just nine months on the job.
Goalkeepers: Filip De Wilde (Sporting Lisbon), Philippe Vande Walle (Ekeren)

Defenders: Philippe Albert (Newcastle), Geoffrey Claeys (Feyenoord), Bertrand Crasson (Napoli), Bart De Roover (Lierse), Dirk Medved (Club Brugge), Lorenzo Staelens (Club Brugge), Olivier Doll (Anderlecht)

Midfielders: Dominique Lemoine (Mouscron), Frederic Pierre (Molenbeek), Gunther Schepens (Standard Liege), Enzo Scifo (Monaco), Franky Van der Elst (Club Brugge), Nico Van Kerckhoven (Lierse), Gert Verheyen (Club Brugge)
Strikers: Nordin Jbari (Ghent), Lokonda M'Penza (Mouscron), Luc Nilis (PSV Eindhoven), Marc Wilmots (Schalke O4)
